message.title: Solstad Maritime ASA - Letter of Intent for CSV Normand Cutter
message.body:
Skudeneshavn, 13 Aug 2026

Solstad Maritime ASA ("SOMA") has signed a Letter of Intent with a key client to
contract the CSV Normand Cutter. The contract will commence in Q4 2026 / Q1 2027
and have a firm duration of 3 years plus 3 years options thereafter.

The vessel will support subsea operations in West Africa and as part of the
contract, SOMA will deliver, with support from Omega Subsea AS, two work class
ROVs (WROVs) with manning, as well as tooling, survey services, and project
personnel.

The Normand Cutter is a large construction vessel equipped with a 300 tons
active heave compensated crane and a working deck of approximately 1600m2.

The commercial terms and conditions are confidential between the parties.
